'''Nautila''', also known as '''Nautolan''', was the official language spoken by [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], one of the native species of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]].

Nautila could only be properly pronounced underwater due to the use of [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] that were dispersed in the water in addition to spoken sounds. In any other environment, the language lost such a great amount of detail, that Nautolans found it annoying.<ref name="FaD" />

To avoid using Nautila out of water, Nautolans learned [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], if they thought they would travel to other planets of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. More Glee Anselm-oriented Nautolans learned [[Anselmian]] language, the language of their non-amphibious neighbors from Glee Anselm, the [[Anselmi/Legends|Anselmi]], instead of Basic. It was unusual to find a trilingual Nautolan, speaking Nautila, Anselmian, ''and'' Basic.
